project: Murali Resort | Premium Resort & Convention Center — Vijayawada
auditor: AI Website Design Auditor & Remediation Engine (Floto Workflow Quality Gate)
verificationScope: All 4 Canonical Routes across Desktop (1440x900), Mobile (390x844), and Tablet (768x1024) Viewports

metricReconciliation.scannerViolationsDescription: 4 initial automated violations reported by @axe-core/playwright across viewports: 3 'label-content-name-mismatch' on /home (Desktop, Mobile, Tablet) + 1 'color-contrast' on /facilities (Desktop).
metricReconciliation.issueRegisterDescription: 10 comprehensive findings registered across Usability (2), Accessibility (5), Target Size / WCAG 2.5.8 (1), Typography (1), and Copy (1).
metricReconciliation.undersizedTargetsBreakdown: 16 total interactive elements flagged with hitboxes under 24x24px prior to remediation: 7 desktop nav links on /home, 3 desktop nav links on /facilities, 3 desktop nav links on /gallery, and 3 on /contact (Leaflet marker + 2 contact info lines). All now measure >= 32px to 48px height.
metricReconciliation.wordSpacingBreakdown: 3 pages (/facilities, /gallery, /contact) affected by TextReveal component omitting whitespace between words in DOM textContent.

findings.title: Visible text not matching accessible name on hero scroll button
findings.verificationEvidence: Artificial aria-label attribute removed. Computed accessible name strictly matches visible text 'Scroll to explore' (100% prefix match, no false animation-skip claims). Verified via Playwright automation.

findings.title: Visible label mismatch in accessible name for spaces catalog link
findings.verificationEvidence: Redundant aria-label removed from #tab-more. Computed accessible name strictly matches visible text 'View All Spaces'. Axe violation resolved across Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet.

findings.title: Insufficient color contrast on active navigation capsule link
findings.verificationEvidence: Active navigation text rendered in high-luminance warm cream #F5EBE0 on blurred backdrop capsule (measured rgb(245, 235, 224) on oklab(0 0 0 / 0.65)). Measured contrast ratio > 6.2:1, exceeding WCAG 1.4.3 AA 4.5:1 threshold.

findings.title: Dead 'Celebrations' navigation link caused by preventDefault
findings.verificationEvidence: Celebrations navigation verified end-to-end: clicking link from /facilities routes cleanly to /home#moments and scrolls to scrollY: 4206 (momentsTop: 0). Clicking link while on /home smoothly scrolls to #moments (scrollY: 3914). Mobile drawer navigates to /home#moments and closes automatically.

findings.title: Desktop navigation links have tap/click target height below 24px
findings.verificationEvidence: Bounding box dimensions measured on live page: Facilities active link measures 60px wide by 40px high with py-2 inline-flex styling, satisfying WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size of 24x24px.

findings.title: TextReveal component omits space characters in DOM text content
findings.verificationEvidence: Natural word spacing restored in DOM textContent: 'See our spaces in person' (/facilities), 'Picture Your Event Here' (/gallery), 'The Journey Begins Here.' (/contact). Verified via textContent string inspection.

findings.title: Robotic jargon and developer implementation notes in Enquiry status screen
findings.verificationEvidence: Copy rewritten to polished hospitality tone: 'Enquiry Details Ready' / 'Your enquiry has been prepared and is ready to send. To receive an immediate response and confirm available dates, connect directly with our reservation concierge via WhatsApp or phone:'. WhatsApp message preserves all enquiry details (name, phone, email, event type, message).

findings.title: Inconsistent rectangular submit button in Enquiry form
findings.verificationEvidence: Submit button styled with rounded-full, aligning with Tier 1 solid button design token across the luxury design system.

findings.title: Inactive desktop facilities panels exposed to assistive technology and keyboard focus order
findings.verificationEvidence: Inert and aria-hidden={!isActive} implemented on all 5 inactive desktop panels. Browser automation verified 19 keyboard tab stops with 0 focus events entering inactive containers. Corrected WCAG mapping from 4.1.2 to 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).

findings.title: Interactive Leaflet marker touch target size below 24px
findings.verificationEvidence: Leaflet DivIcon configured with iconSize [48, 48] (measured exactly 48x48px). Contact telephone lines and email addresses upgraded to interactive links with min-h-[32px] (measured 101x32px, 145x32px, 97x32px). 0 undersized targets remain.
